label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 20
title: MVP: webhooks - inbound intake signatures + outbound alert/notification webhooks
body: No webhook support exists today. Add: (a) INBOUND verification/auth for the Intake API (POST /intake) used by adapters; (b) OUTBOUND webhooks to external systems for alerts/notifications, driven by core/event_bus.py events (stuck/anomaly/coverage_gap/escalation/follow_up_due) and pipeline/project failures - HMAC-signed, retry with backoff, per-endpoint subscription + delivery log.
